title: S11 validation report
description: docs/validation.md's degradation ladder. ladder_rung is R4 only in this phase (static schema conformance of code-level emission points, a hard ceiling for this rung, not situational) -- R2's own defining check (per-DTO event-emission assertion) needs skills/s10-instrumenter/SKILL.md to name a concrete telemetry API first, not built yet. regression_gate wires E6 R2's already-built sandbox mechanism into the deterministic layer's own step 1 ('instrumentation must not break the product') independent of ladder_rung -- a real, opt-in dynamic check, not a re-badging of R4. R1/R3 (running the product live, a real OTLP collector, real traffic, the agentic audit panel) all need real target execution beyond the test suite, not attempted here -- ladder_rung and verdict grow further when they land, not silently redefined.

verdict.description: needs_review: R4's own ceiling (static-only), or --dynamic ran and the regression gate didn't fail. validation_failed: regression_gate actually ran the target's test suite in the sandbox and it failed after instrumentation -- docs/validation.md's deterministic-layer step 1, independent of ladder_rung. Never 'validated' -- that needs real R2/R1 evidence, not built yet.

regression_gate.description: docs/validation.md's deterministic layer step 1 ('instrumentation must not break the product'), wired via E6 R2's sandbox mechanism (oah/validate/sandbox.py, pytest_runner.py) -- NOT R2 itself, which additionally needs per-DTO event-emission assertion, not built. Only meaningful when --dynamic was passed to `oah validate`; otherwise 'not_attempted'.

status.description: not_attempted: --dynamic not passed. skipped: --dynamic passed but inconclusive (Docker unavailable, no test suite found, or the install ladder failed) -- never evidence the target is broken. passed: the target's real test suite ran and passed in the sandbox. failed: it ran and something failed -- the only status that forces verdict=validation_failed.

results.description: One entry per DTO in the input implementation_dto.json, in the same order. Empty array is valid (no DTOs given).

status.description: present: every expected_events[].required_attributes string was found in change.file at or after change.anchor -- a code-level presence claim only, not a runtime guarantee. absent: at least one was missing (missing_attributes names which). skipped: this DTO was never applied by S10 (status != 'applied' in the instrument report, or missing from it entirely) -- nothing to check, never silently omitted from results.

missing_attributes.description: Present only when status is 'absent'; null otherwise.

reason.description: Required context for 'skipped' (why this DTO has no applied code to check); null otherwise.
